title: Predicting hormone receptor status in tumors: An innovative approach using breast ultrasound-radiomics combined model.
authors: Yin, Xue; Wang, Zhen; Zhao, Qinxian; Zhang, Xincun; Sang, Tian; Shao, Changjie
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用超声影像组学预测乳腺癌激素受体状态，属于纯临床影像诊断，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Hormone receptor (HR) status is a critical biomarker used to formulate treatment programs and prognosis in breast cancer. Traditional immunohistochemistry relies on invasive tissue samples and may not accurately reflect tumor heterogeneity. Radiomics is a noninvasive technique that involves extracting quantitative imaging characteristics from molecular profiles. The purpose of this study is to develop a combined ultrasound (US)-radiomics model to predict HR status in invasive breast cancer. A retrospective cohort of 186 patients with invasive breast carcinoma, which had been pathologically confirmed, was used in this study, comprising 150 cases (HR-positive (ER+/PR-, HER-2-)) and 36 cases (HR-negative (ER-/PR-, HER-2-)). B-mode US images of the tumor regions were manually segmented, and 463 radiomic features were obtained. T tests, ANOVA, and recursive methods were applied to create a list of features. A support vector machine with a radial basis function kernel was trained using leave-one-out cross-validation. To measure model performance, accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, area under the curve (AUC), and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were used. The hybrid model had an AUC of 0.728 (95% CI: 0.701-0.755) and an accuracy of 67.9. The model with the highest AUC (0.753, 95% CI: 0.7240.782) was the internal echo-based model. HR-negative tumors were larger, had higher marker of proliferation (Ki-67) indices, and showed greater textural heterogeneity than HR-positive lesions (P < .05). US-radiomics combined modeling is a promising, cost-effective, and radiation-free approach to noninvasive imaging that can predict HR status in breast cancer. US biomarkers can be quantitative, providing insights into tumor microstructure to personalize diagnostic and therapeutic approaches.
abstract_zh: 激素受体（HR）状态是制定乳腺癌治疗方案和预后评估的关键生物标志物。传统免疫组织化学依赖侵入性组织样本，可能无法准确反映肿瘤异质性。放射组学是一种非侵入性技术，涉及从分子谱中提取定量影像特征。本研究旨在开发一种结合超声（US）和放射组学的模型，以预测浸润性乳腺癌的HR状态。研究纳入186例经病理确诊的浸润性乳腺癌患者回顾性队列，包括150例HR阳性（ER+/PR-，HER-2-）和36例HR阴性（ER-/PR-，HER-2-）病例。对肿瘤区域的B模式超声图像进行手动分割，提取463个放射组学特征。采用t检验、方差分析和递归方法生成特征列表。使用留一法交叉验证训练具有径向基函数核的支持向量机。模型性能通过准确率、敏感性、特异性、曲线下面积（AUC）和95%置信区间（CI）进行评估。混合模型的AUC为0.728（95% CI：0.701-0.755），准确率为67.9%。AUC最高（0.753，95% CI：0.724-0.782）的模型是基于内部回声的模型。HR阴性肿瘤体积更大，增殖标志物（Ki-67）指数更高，且纹理异质性较HR阳性病变更显著（P < .05）。超声-放射组学联合建模是一种有前景、成本效益高且无辐射的非侵入性影像方法，可预测乳腺癌HR状态。超声生物标志物可定量化，为肿瘤微结构提供见解，从而个性化诊断和治疗策略。
